gpus.note: Shaders run best with Zink (Vulkan) on this GPU; the launcher picks it automatically when Iris is installed.
Prefer light shader packs and a render scale of 50-75 %.
Use MobileGlues for shaders on Mali. Freedreno/Turnip drivers are Adreno-only.

drivers.note: The bundled Turnip (Mesa 24.3) does not support Adreno 825; the launcher falls back to the system Vulkan driver. Community Turnip builds with Adreno 825 support can be imported in Settings > Renderer > Local plugins.
The bundled Turnip driver supports this GPU and is usually faster than the system driver with Zink.
